description: Make Retry Behavior 2.1 the default for standard and adaptive retry modes and remove the AWS_NEW_RETRIES_2026 flag. HTTP 429 is now retried as a throttling error when the response does not deserialize to a modeled error type. Custom BackoffDelayer and Retryer.RetryDelay implementations now receive a 0-based retry index (the first retry is 0). An explicitly configured NewExponentialJitterBackoff keeps its previous delays.
